about: Site updates shown on /changes. One entry per working session, a sentence or two: changes within 2 hours of the newest entry's time go into it (and its time moves to now); otherwise a new entry goes on top. It does not have to cover everything. See CLAUDE.md.

updates.text: Import works out which spreadsheet column is the park and which is the coaster, and new riders can jump to it from the first setup step. Opening a Global ride lists who ranked it where on one line per place instead of a wall of name tags.

On your profile the Account menu now sits beside the rider switcher, with Log a day and your rankings next to your stats on a phone. Other riders' profiles no longer show how many coasters you've both ridden.

Park, manufacturer, model, location and coaster pages now share one layout, /log has one search box and keeps staged rides through a reload, and Explore leads with Parks and Coasters. Every Global list now shows the average with your own place under it in grey, and Credits and Map open with your name and count like your profile.

Coaster, park, manufacturer, model and location pages were reworked: your verdict up top, Global rankings first, rider pictures, ones you still need listed first, and long lists that fold to Show all. Signed in, the home page opens on your own count, and dark mode is a deeper night blue.

New /users page lists everyone A–Z with site-wide totals, and the home page now shows the top ten with a link to it. Phone lists and opened rows are tighter, and profiles have a rankings button for everyone.

Page headers now carry a little park skyline — a Magnum-style coaster in side view with its train cresting the hill, a Ferris wheel, a drop tower and swings — lit up at night on a deep navy, and on a sky-blue gradient by day. Dark mode is navy instead of grey throughout.

Every coaster, park and model list on the site — including your credits and recent visits — now shares one row style that matches /rankings, with a Mine / Global ranking on manufacturer, model and location pages. Rides pulled out of a category show how far above or below it they sit.

New riders get a two-minute setup that ends with a head-to-head top ten, and Rank more makes ranking the rest easy. Rankings can be filtered by model, and Manufacturers is now A–Z with each maker's stats opening right in the list.
A day copied to a friend now shows in the feed a minute after the original.
Relocated rides now count as one credit with one page, search forgives typos and knows park initials, and the homepage and profile got tidier.
